faq.title: A few useful questions.
faq.q1: What can I manage with Fitivo?
faq.a1: Fitivo connects members, memberships, recorded payments, receipts, attendance and your team’s daily work. Reporting and other capabilities depend on your plan and permissions.
faq.a2: When public registration is available, eligible new gym owners can create an account and start a seven-day trial without a payment card. Trial eligibility is checked during registration. Paid access after the trial requires verified payment. If registration is closed, use the access options on the registration page.
faq.a3: Yes. Owners can give staff access to everyday member, payment and attendance workflows according to their permissions. Team capacity and staff-management capabilities depend on the workspace’s plan.
faq.q4: Can trainers have their own access?
faq.a4: Yes. Trainers have a focused workspace for assigned members and relevant membership and attendance information. A separate member login portal is not currently available.
faq.a5: Yes. Your team can record member payments, including partial payments, review dues and find receipts. Membership and renewal records provide the context for those payments.
faq.q6: Can I manage multiple gym locations?
faq.a6: Eligible Professional workspaces support multiple branches within the same organization. Branch limits and reporting capabilities follow the workspace’s subscription; branches are not unlimited.
faq.a7: No. Fitivo records payments entered by your team. It does not automatically charge members or collect their fees.
